name: comp-330
title: Change Plan Dialog
description: A trigger opens a tall narrow dialog listing three plans as radio rows with prices, a checked feature list below, and Change plan and Cancel buttons.
use: An existing customer needs to switch tiers without leaving the app screen.
avoid: Prices, plan names and feature lines are fixed, and Change plan has no submit action.
a11y: Plan rows are proper radios with descriptions, but each row removes its own outline and relies on the radio's focus ring. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Closed, an outlined Change plan button. Open, a tall narrow dark dialog with a refresh icon, a title and grey subtitle, three bordered rows each holding a name, price and radio, the picked row tinted, then a six-line ticked feature list, a white Change plan and a ghost Cancel.
behaves: Choosing a row moves the tint and fills its radio; Standard starts selected. Change plan does nothing, and Cancel, Escape or the X closes.
customise: Plan names, prices, feature list and the default selection are hardcoded; the component takes no props.
weight: light: One dialog with a three-item radio group and a static list.
demo: Plans Essential at $4, Standard at $19 and Enterprise at $32 per member/month, with six feature lines.
issues: Change plan has no handler, so the selected plan is not applied.
Prices are fixed to monthly per-member billing with no interval switch.
polishWhy: Clear plan chooser with a real selected state; the inert confirm is the only gap.
